close_reason: Fixed: render_mta_sts_policy now uses CRLF per RFC 8461 §3.2; test oracle updated to 9ebad69d...
description:
render_mta_sts_policy (server.rs:333) builds the policy body with bare '
' line endings. RFC 8461 §3.2 states 'A valid policy file MUST ... use CRLF line endings.' Trigger: a remote MTA that strictly validates RFC 8461 §3.2 fetches our /.well-known/mta-sts.txt and rejects it, preventing delivery to our hosted domains. Fix: replace '
' with '
' in render_mta_sts_policy.
title: render_mta_sts_policy serves LF-only but RFC 8461 §3.2 requires CRLF
